pageCache.pageTitle: Field Court Junior Academy Quedgeley - Home Page
pageCache.text:
Our Facebook Page
PLEASE NOTE WE ARE BUILDING A NEW WEBSITE “BEHIND THE SCENES” WHICH WE HOPE TO LAUNCH SOON. THIS WEBSITE WILL STILL PROVIDE SOME RELEVANT INFORMATION BUT IS NOT BEING KEPY ROUTINELY UP TO DATE.
We hope you find the information you are looking for by following the links on this website to learn all about Field Court Junior Academy, where children are S.T.A.R.S. in the making
S- Self Confident, T-Trustworthy, A- Aspirational, R- Resilient, S-Socially Minded
We are a three form entry junior school in the heart of the thriving community of Quedgeley. Judged as 'Outstanding' by Ofsted in 2014, we are continually striving to improve further and to remain as the school of choice in the local area.
Alternatively, if you are a fellow teaching professional and you're interested in what we do, we are more than happy to host visits to our school... simply contact us and we can discuss your requirements.
We hope to see you soon!
Field Court Junior Academy and Reed Education, working together in partnership.
